Lack of social support after childbirth
cohort: 1223 German-speaking women who had given birth
finding: Different modes of delivery were associated with varying levels of PPD and PTSD, with emergency and indicated cesarean sections and assisted vaginal deliveries linked to higher PTSD levels.
mod_finding: Secondary cesarean section from relative indication, emergency secondary CS, and assisted vaginal delivery were associated with elevated levels of PTSD, while certain cesarean section types were linked to higher PPD compared to vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: between four weeks and twelve months postpartum
